title: Cajun & Creole Culinary Culture
summary: Cajun & Creole: Cajun seasoning, rice, butter.
origins: Cajun & Creole cuisine reflects american geography, trade routes, and home cooking traditions passed through generations.
history: Regional pride — smoke, cast iron, and generous portions with table-side adjustment.
teaching: Smoke and spice rubs, fond from cast iron, vinegar or hot sauce at the table for balance.
Cast iron, BBQ sauce, chili powder, and good black pepper.
Signature pairing: Cajun seasoning + rice + butter.
